quests.desc: Welcome to TextWorld! Here is your task for today. First off, if it's not too much trouble, I need you to make an effort to move north. Then, pick up the key from the rack in the cellar. With the key, check that the portal within the cellar is unlocked with the key. After unlocking the portal, ensure that the portal is open. And then, go to the east. Okay, and then, recover the type R keycard from the display inside the spare room. And then, unlock the type R chest. After that, ensure that the type R chest inside the spare room is open. Alright, thanks!

infos.name: spare room
infos.desc:
You've entered a spare room.

 You rest your hand against a wall, but you miss the wall and fall onto a type R chest. You idly wonder how they came up with the name TextWorld for this place. It's pretty fitting.[if c_0 is open and there is something in the c_0] The type R chest contains [a list of things in the c_0].[end if][if c_0 is open and the c_0 contains nothing] Empty! What kind of nightmare TextWorld is this?[end if] You can make out a display. You shudder, but continue examining the room.[if c_1 is open and there is something in the c_1] The display contains [a list of things in the c_1].[end if][if c_1 is open and the c_1 contains nothing] What a letdown! The display is empty![end if] Were you looking for a workbench? Because look over there, it's a workbench. The workbench is ordinary.[if there is something on the s_1] On the workbench you can make out [a list of things on the s_1]. Suddenly, you bump your head on the ceiling, but it's not such a bad bump that it's going to prevent you from looking at objects and even things.[end if][if there is nothing on the s_1] But the thing is empty, unfortunately. What, you think everything in TextWorld should have stuff on it?[end if]

 There is [if d_0 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] door leading east. There is [if d_1 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] portal leading west. You need an unblocked exit? You should try going north.

infos.name: cellar
infos.desc:
You are in a cellar. A standard one.

 You can make out a rack. The rack is standard.[if there is something on the s_0] On the rack you make out [a list of things on the s_0].[end if][if there is nothing on the s_0] The rack appears to be empty.[end if]

 There is [if d_1 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] portal leading east. You need an unguarded exit? You should try going south.

infos.name: pantry
infos.desc:
You have walked into a pantry. Not the pantry you'd expect. No, this is a pantry.



 There is [if d_0 is open]an open[otherwise]a closed[end if] door leading west. You don't like doors? Why not try going north, that entranceway is unblocked.

infos.name: studio
infos.desc:
You've just shown up in a studio.



There is an unblocked exit to the north.

infos.name: vault
infos.desc:
Ah, the vault. This is some kind of vault, really great typical vibes in this place, a wonderful typical atmosphere. And now, well, you're in it. You start to take note of what's in the room.



You need an unguarded exit? You should try going south.

infos.name: basement
infos.desc:
Well, here we are in a basement. You begin looking for stuff.



There is an exit to the south. Don't worry, it is unguarded.

objective: I hope you're ready to go into rooms and interact with objects, because you've just entered TextWorld! Here is how to play! First stop, go north. And then, take the key from the rack in the cellar. After that, make it so that the portal is unlocked. After unlocking the portal, assure that the portal in the cellar is wide open. Then, make an attempt to go to the east. With that done, pick up the type R keycard from the display inside the spare room. After that, unlock the type R chest within the spare room with the type R keycard. And then, make sure that the type R chest in the spare room is ajar. Alright, thanks!
